description: Use this when the user asks what Upfit's coach says or checks for a specific bodyweight exercise (for example 'squat' or 'low plank hold'). Returns the app's real spoken coach lines for that exercise and, for exercises that have an Upfit page, what the camera checks and does not check. If the exercise is unknown it says so and lists close matches. It never invents form advice.

exercise.description: Exercise name, such as 'squat', 'jumping jacks' or 'low plank hold'.

name: get_exercise_form_cues
title: Get an exercise's form cues
